scientific_integrity: Analytic all-size proof with optional exact rational enumeration for \(2\le n\le8\); no external or independent certification.
scientific_limitations: Finite uniform random permutations, one independently sampled adjacent position, exact signed jump; event is site-count size biased. General constrained-cycle identities not exhaustively ruled out as earlier coverage.
title: Cycle laws conditional on signed adjacent jumps in random permutations
